complex.interior_rounding: FP64 interpolation of FP32 endpoints, cast to original parameter dtype; exact endpoint copies
complex.interpretation: Not a Muon/AdamW learning-rate sweep: optimizer moments, clipping and weight decay are computed once at the saved rate.
complex.localization_interpretation: Counterfactual audio effects of subsets of the same cached update, not additive responsibility percentages. The first three groups partition parameters; Muon and AdamW are a second partition.
complex.method: parameter interpolation along one fixed native D-then-G delta
complex.metric_aggregation: equal-crop means on the same fixed probe panel, historical six-sample interior exclusion
